title: 65 corrections to human evolution as a planted marker

tellings.quote: is stuff like you know, the aliens had made 65 corrections to um you know, in the evolution of humans and things and

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S-4 in 1988 and 1989, says the briefing papers he read there stated that the aliens had made "65 corrections" to human evolution. He tells Michels this while bringing up a man he calls Barry. If true, it would mean people did not evolve on their own, and that someone deliberately shaped us.
